title: Capacity — structural placeholder
description: Separate accounts of structural possibility and what an exact Locality can presently bear, sustain, or exercise.
$comment: Annotation-only placeholder: accepts every instance; no conformance or constitutional effect is established.

locality.description: Exact Locality for which capacity is considered.

scope.description: Exact act or burden and the bounds of the capacity claim.

time.description: Time for which support is claimed; past support does not establish present capacity.

conditions.description: Conditions under which each capacity account holds.

structural_capacity.description: What a Form or architecture leaves possible, with its own support and limits.

situated_capacity.description: What this Locality can presently bear, sustain, or exercise, with separate support and limits.

reconciliation.description: Local, time-sensitive relation between the two accounts without equating them.

uncertainty.description: Missing or disputed support, without general incapacity inferred from a scoped limitation.
